rule: Item 2: per outcome row with an A loss, the anchor book is the landed _receipts(book rows, response_end_ts, request_start_ts, tick instant) recomputed per tick with the landed _mid applied to each receipt (a refusal is counted book_mid_refused and skipped); the last valid (instant, mid) must equal (book_ts, mid) or the night is RECONCILE_FAILED (anchor_book_mismatch). tau_a = anchor_projection.run_starts over that sequence at its last index; lag 0; integer microseconds from the landed _instant. Streams come from the landed _receipts(state rows, as_of) live rows through the landed mlb_entries: MLB play = _instant(last_play_ts) with the _mlb_state_row tuple; NBA tuple (home-away, period, rem_minutes(period,0)*60+clock_sec) with play = request_start of the last live receipt that carried the previous tuple (the first live receipt uses its own). Precedence: sport not mlb/nba -> m2_not_defined; an unavailable source of the sport -> source_unavailable; mid_age_us <= 15000000 -> fresh_anchor; no live entry or no known state -> no_known_state; else anchor_projection.project(stream, t, 0, home-view mid, tau_a, sport, sigma 22.0 nba / None mlb). M2 is the tick mid string unless projected, then repr(float) oriented back to the ticker. Brier (D(M2)-D(y))**2 unclipped; M2 in {0,1} counted m2_at_bound. Nothing is fitted. Item 3: class post_final / terminal from the landed S545 census flags, else pre_live when segment is pre-live, else live; age fresh when mid_age_us <= 15000000 else stale; cells sport x class x segment(early, middle, late, all) x age(fresh, stale, all) with per-game exact Decimal sums in sorted (game_key, ts) order and cboot(2000, 13). Item 4: headline per sport = cumulative class live, segment all, age stale delta M2 - A with its CI: INSUFFICIENT when n_games < 30, else M2_LOWER_BRIER when hi < 0, M2_HIGHER_BRIER when lo > 0, else NO_RESOLVED_DIFFERENCE; MLB is INSUFFICIENT by declaration in this row; sports other than mlb and nba carry M2 = A. Outside production mode (a tmp prereg or an out-dir outside the repo) every headline verdict is DESCRIPTIVE. A paired row whose y differs from its tick outcome refuses night_row_invalid.
